Players who mention gameplay most often praise the run variety and the overall roguelike structure, with one calling it "Honestly one of the better roguelikes this year" and another describing it as a "Solid deckbuilder." Positive comments also single out co-op play, boss design, and performance on the Steam Deck. The same reviews frequently pair that praise with specific frustrations: the inventory UI "fights me constantly," matchmaking is called bad, and the pacing "drags in act two." One player notes the game is "a bit short for the price," while another warns that the servers are shutting down next month, advising others to "grab it on sale if at all."

Opinion splits appear mainly around difficulty and length. The boss design is called "excellent" and the difficulty curve "brutal but fair," yet the same review flags the act-two pacing. The subtitle font is a recurring minor complaint. Across the sampled reviews, the positive mentions outnumber the negative ones by a wide margin, but the criticisms that do appear are consistent and practical: UI friction, matchmaking, and value for money. Players recommend the game to friends despite these issues, suggesting the core loop outweighs the rough edges for most who bring up gameplay.
